source.film: KODAK VISION3 250D Color Negative Film 5207 / 7207 / SO-207

notes: The URL is an archive. Kodak's current edition (July 2015) prints its curves as pictures,
which can't be read exactly; this 2009 edition draws them as vector paths.
Sensitometric curves: 5500 K daylight, 1/50 s, Process ECN-2, Status M densitometry. The
exposure axis is calibrated from the camera-stop ticks, one stop being 0.301 log H, with
stop 0 at log H -1.3 as labelled: the grey card's exposure at EI 250, so Log H ref. The
plot's lux-second ticks agree (-3.1 sits at stop -6, where this calibration puts -3.106).
Spectral sensitivity (page 4): Process ECN-2, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min. Spectral
dye density (page 4): ECN-2, D-mins subtracted; a midscale neutral and the minimum
density (drawn dashed, as one continuous path).
Page coordinates: the plots' axes are calibrated from their tick marks.
